0.original: The saint's little helper in the Lavender Beds seeks your assistance in running the Starlight Celebration festivities.<hex:02100103>※This quest is available for a limited time only.

1.original: You have volunteered your services to assist with the Starlight Celebration festivities. Pull on your Starlight tunic, and collect a child's message from one of the Starlight sentinels found within the Lavender Beds.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

2.original: You have collected a letter to the Spinner. Return to Yainu-Par and deliver the message to the saint's little helper.

3.original: You have delivered the message to the grateful little helper. Take the gift from the festival volunteer, and hand it to the child waiting nearby.

4.original: You have performed your duty as a little helper, and brought gift-wrapped happiness to a child. Report to the saint's little helper in Yainu-Par.

5.original: The volunteer is pleased with your efforts, and looks forward to your continuing assistance during the remainder of the Starlight Celebration.

24.original: Equip the Starlight tunic and collect a letter to the Spinner from a Starlight sentinel.

25.original: Deliver the letter to the Spinner to the saint's little helper.

26.original: Equip the Starlight tunic and deliver the lucky star to the waiting youngling.

27.original: Report to the saint's little helper.

48.original: Filled with the spirit of giving, are we? Let's set you to your task, then.

49.original: All you need to do is collect a single child's message from one of the Starlight sentinels within the Lavender Beds...all while wearing your Starlight tunic, of course.

50.original: As you know, there is the tree we helpers set up here in Yainu-Par, but there are also decorated sentinels to be found in the gardens of your fellow adventurers' estates.

51.original: You should also know that the type of fallen star you receive for your efforts will depend on the sentinel from which the message is retrieved.

52.original: Did we talk about fallen stars? It's a simple system we devised to reward hardworking volunteers─a type of festive currency that can be exchanged for seasonal goods. Speak with the Starlight crier if you'd like to know more!

53.original: The position of Starlight sentinels will be displayed on your minimap. Search the residential area to pinpoint their locations!

54.original: You can only obtain one seasonal message at a time, so choose your sentinel wisely! Keep in mind which fallen stars are needed to purchase the seasonal goods you wish to acquire.

55.original: Pray bring me a message from any of the Starlight sentinels found within the Lavender Beds. Oh, and don't forget to don your scarlet apparel!

56.original: The position of Starlight sentinels will be displayed on your minimap. Search the residential area to pinpoint their locations!

57.original: You can only obtain one seasonal message at a time, so choose your sentinel wisely! Keep in mind which fallen stars are needed to purchase the seasonal goods you wish to acquire.

58.original: You must have the Starlight tunic equipped to continue with this quest.

59.original: If you have misplaced your Starlight tunic, speak with a Starlight Celebration crier to receive a replacement.

60.original: You've lost your Starlight tunic? Never fear! We've enough spares to dress a small army! Here, take another one!

62.original: Hello again! You've returned with one of the children's messages, I trust?

63.original: Excellent. Now comes the fun part! Take this gift, and deliver it to the waiting youngling. Remember: the wee ones expect someone dressed as a little helper!

64.original: You should find an expectant child waiting nearby. Don't forget to dress the part!

65.original: A little helper! Yay! Do you have my present!? Can I have my present now!?

66.original: I got a pre-sent!♪<hex:02100103>A present from the go-ddess!♪<hex:02100103>Thank you, little helper!

68.original: ...Can I really have this? Thank you so much!

69.original: Wow, are you <hex:021A020203>really<hex:021A020103> a little helper? Well, I've been good this year, so is it okay if I get my gift now...?

70.original: Thank you! I'll be sure not to play too rough...

71.original: I'm waiting here for the little helper to bring my present! I wonder what's taking so long...

72.original: Have you seen a little helper anywhere? Maybe they forgot about me...

73.original: If I wait right here, a little helper is supposed to bring me a gift. That's what they said...

74.original: You must have the Starlight tunic equipped to continue with this quest.

75.original: If you have misplaced your Starlight tunic, speak with a Starlight Celebration crier to receive a replacement.

76.original: You've lost your Starlight tunic? Never fear! We've enough spares to dress a small army! Here, take another one!

78.original: You've returned to me empty-handed. Good! I do hope the youngling enjoys the gift!

79.original: Amh Garanjy does so dearly love to see the children smile. When I once marveled at her dedication, the celebrant explained that her fervor grew from her troubled past as an orphan.

80.original: She would spare any child the misery and loneliness she experienced, even if it meant funding the entire Starlight Celebration by washing dirty dishes at the Carline Canopy for a year.

81.original: And I must admit, her intensity is quite contagious! I assume you must feel it too, otherwise why else would you find yourself compelled to help us again and again?

82.original: I believe I heard the delighted laughter from here! Good show, little helper! I hope I can count on your assistance again in the future!

83.original: You have contributed to the Starlight Celebration in every residential district! Report to Amh Garanjy in the Lavender Beds.
